race.description: Rmbl Investments Rising Stars Race Hcp (Bm56)
race.comment: MARILYN'S EDGE (1) disappointed in a BM62 at Horsham last start, yet her previous Mildura third as favourite was strong. Carries the big weight, but her recent ratings stack up and Kennedy's claim comes in handy. Can put her best foot forward. SISTINE TUNNEL (11) is better than what she showed at Geelong and has been scratched since on vet's advice. Been a while between wins, though her best form is good enough for a race like this. BLISS BOMB (9) just missed last start at Kyneton on the quick turnaround and she has claims on that effort. GLISK (4) won first-up last campaign and her latest jumpout suggests she can feature on resumption again.
